In sync mode refreshOAuthTokens (packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts) returns the raw fetch `Response`, which has no `.data` property. The immediately following line `if (!tokenInfo.data.error)` therefore accesses `.error` on undefined and throws a TypeError whenever APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED and CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT are set, breaking Zoho Bigin token refresh.

judged_text: In sync mode refreshOAuthTokens returns a fetch Response, and the immediately following retained code evaluates tokenInfo.data.error — Response has no .data property, so tokenInfo.data is undefined and .error throws TypeError. With APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED and CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT set, every Zoho Bigin token refresh crashes with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading error)' instead of refreshing credentials.

record.issue_text: [BUG] In sync mode refreshOAuthTokens returns a fetch Response, and the immediately following retained code evaluates tokenInfo.data.error — Response has no .data property, so tokenInfo.data is undefined and .error throws TypeError. With APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED and CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT set, every Zoho Bigin token refresh crashes with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading error)' instead of refreshing credentials.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` is true, the function executes `fetch(...)` and returns the raw Fetch `Response`. In `packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `tokenInfo` is assigned from `await refreshOAuthTokens(...)` and then the existing code immediately checks `if (!tokenInfo.data.error) { ... }`. A Fetch `Response` object does not have a `.data` property (unlike an Axios response), so in sync mode `tokenInfo.data` will be `undefined` and `tokenInfo.data.error` will throw a `TypeError`, matching the finding.
